title: custom instructions / Manage project and personal instructions
content: ## Manage project and personal instructions Return to **Instructions** in the Agent Customizations editor to find and edit existing instructions. To add personal instructions, select `+` next to **User**. Follow the prompts for a name and storage location supported by your harness, save the file, and verify it in a new chat with that harness. Use user scope for personal preferences across projects. Don't put your individual response preferences in a shared project file unless your team wants them too. For locations and synchronization limits, see [user instructions](/docs/agents/reference/custom-instructions-reference.md#user-instructions). You can also distribute instructions as rule components in an [agent plugin](/docs/agent-customization/agent-plugins.md#what-plugins-provide), alongside related agents, skills, or tools. Support depends on the selected harness and plugin format. Check [plugin compatibility](/docs/agent-customization/agent-plugins.md#cross-tool-compatibility) before sharing the bundle across clients.
